metadata.timing_note: total_wall_time is measured around the complete run_topopt_from_json call; legacy_reconstructed_time is retained as average_iteration_time * iter_total.
metadata.na_representation: JSON null and CSV N/A mean not applicable or unavailable.
metadata.iteration_fields: iter_total counts all optimization iterations; iter_stage1 and iter_stage2 are Yuksel stages and sum to iter_total; shares are percentages; outer and inner apply only to methods with a two-level loop (Olhoff: Fig. 1 outer loop and subproblem (25) solves) and are null otherwise.

field_definitions.initialization_time_s: Configuration parsing, dispatch, and solver setup before optimization.
field_definitions.optimization_loop_time_s: Time measured inside optimization loops; Yuksel is Stage 1 plus Stage 2.
field_definitions.postprocessing_time_s: Final modal analysis and other work after optimization loops.
field_definitions.total_wall_time_s: Caller-side wall time around the complete run_topopt_from_json call.
field_definitions.iter_stage1: Yuksel compliance-stage iterations; N/A for single-stage methods.
field_definitions.iter_stage2: Yuksel inertial-stage iterations; N/A for single-stage methods.
field_definitions.outer: Outer-loop iterations for two-level methods; N/A otherwise.
field_definitions.inner: Total subproblem solves across all outer iterations; N/A otherwise.
field_definitions.inner_solver: Subproblem solver used for the inner loop, where applicable.
field_definitions.final_rms_density_change: Final RMS design-density change when available.
field_definitions.final_relative_objective_change: Final relative change in the convergence objective (frequency for Olhoff).
field_definitions.final_grayness: Mean 4*x*(1-x) of the final physical density field.
field_definitions.convergence_tolerance: Numerical convergence tolerance actually used; criteria are unchanged.

metadata.olhoff_column_note: The Olhoff column is the stabilized S1 profile from analysis/olhoff_stabilization_audit/: the Du-Olhoff 2007 clean-room reproduction at r_min = 1.3 elements with a causal move reduction 0.005 -> 0.0025, triggered by 100 consecutive native evaluations with N == 2 and gap12 <= 1%. It ends at a FIXED 1600 outer iterations. THE ENDPOINT IS NOT NATIVE CONVERGENCE and the trigger is not a convergence test; no convergence-speed claim may be inferred from it. This is NOT the legacy S0 / r_min = 2 benchmark profile.

benchmark_profile.mode_note: Ultimate nine-resolution performance/scaling campaign under the frozen per-method profiles; Olhoff uses the stabilized S1 profile at a FIXED 1600-outer work horizon, which is NOT native convergence.

Olhoff.work_semantics: fixed 1600 outer iterations with causal S1 move stabilization; NOT NATIVE CONVERGENCE
Olhoff.fit_rule: include only solver-healthy fixed-work rows; fit measured loop and per-iteration timing; do not label endpoints converged

Yuksel.work_semantics: native two-stage practical profile; stage counts and times reported separately and in total

campaign_manifest.cross_method_guardrail: Olhoff fixed-work timing and native-stopped Yuksel/Proposed timing must remain semantically labelled; no convergence-speed claim may be inferred from Olhoff's 1600 endpoint
campaign_manifest.source_of_truth: selected_profile.json plus frozen three-method selected profiles

metadata.olhoff_equivalence_note: An Olhoff timing/scaling row is admitted only after verify_repro2007_benchmark_equivalence has proved, for that mesh and this exact profile, source commit, frozen implementation and MATLAB release, that the benchmark-dispatched path reproduces a direct call to the clean-room reproduction bit for bit.  See OLHOFF_BENCHMARK_EQUIVALENCE_REPORT.md. This gate applies to the LEGACY dispatched path only; the final campaign calls the runner named in final_campaign_profile.json directly and is admitted by final_campaign_preflight instead.

status_semantics.note: Censored rows are reported in full in every table and artifact and are excluded from every scaling fit. A cap hit is not convergence and a solver failure is not a timing result.

evaluator_separation.native: Solver-native omega under each method own material model.
evaluator_separation.common_raw: study_evaluate_design E1/E2/E3 on the final raw density field.
evaluator_separation.common_binary: study_evaluate_design E1/E2/E3 on the exact-count volume-preserving binary projection.

timing_protocol.warm_up: one discarded solve per method at 40x5, outside the campaign mesh set
timing_protocol.olhoff_total_wall_time: solver-side wallclock inside olhoffOptStabilized; excludes the evidence .mat save
timing_protocol.olhoff_loop_time: sum of per-iteration eigensolve + gradient + subproblem time
timing_protocol.olhoff_init_post: not separable inside the frozen audit runner; reported null
timing_protocol.comparability_warning: The stabilization audit measured its timings with several single-thread MATLAB processes in parallel. Those numbers are descriptive only and must NOT be compared directly with this serial campaign.
